name: repeated-region-edits
description: The same handler region is edited three times in sequence (change a value, widen a signature, insert a comment). Probes tag rotation through consecutive edits and re-anchoring on changed windows.
prompt: Edit service.js using ONLY the read and edit tools. Make three changes, each in its OWN separate edit call, in this order: (1) change 'const mode = "fast";' to 'const mode = "safe";'; (2) change the handle function signature line to 'function handle(request, options) {' AND its return line to '  return process(request, mode, options);'; (3) insert the comment line '// validate options before processing' directly after the closing '}' of the handle function. Do not use any other tool.
